name: smwmusic-scott-joplin-maple-leaf-rag
title: Scott Joplin - Maple Leaf Rag
description:
A fairly energetic piano song from 1899. This song only uses the SMW piano sample and nothing else. Can work very well as an athletic theme.

It is worth noting that the original piece does not normally loop. This port was given a loop point so that it can be suitable as a BGM.
